description: posix_spawn file actions = redirection (M6-D). The SpawnArgs block now carries serialized file actions; the kernel has the child inherit the parent's fds and applies open/dup2/close to the child's fd table before scheduling it (kernel/src/syscall/mod.rs sys_spawn_args/setup_child_fds + kernel/src/process/mod.rs inherit_fds/place_vfs_fd; VFS open-file refcount in kernel/src/fs/vfs.rs). musl serializes the actions (toolchains/dunit-musl/src/process/posix_spawn.c). userspace/ctests/musl_redir.c redirects a child's stdout to /tmp/redir.out and reads it back. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_redir_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 45 --timeout 240 --boot-timeout 120

required.marker: [REDIR] child stdout redirected to file OK
required.claim: posix_spawn file actions (open+dup2+close) redirected the child's stdout into a file, read back by the parent

forbidden.why: redirection via file actions did not work
